run_plm_finetune: run permutation language modeling fine-tuning on XLNet with a HuggingFace dataset
run_plm_train_eval: run XLNet permutation language modeling training and evaluation with custom text files
create_plm_data_collator: create a DataCollatorForPermutationLanguageModeling with custom plm_probability and max_span_length
group_texts_concatenate: group and concatenate tokenized text chunks to max_seq_length for language modeling
run_plm_from_scratch: train a new XLNet model from scratch with config overrides and a custom tokenizer
